text:
anna: FYI from onboarding call — customer blocked by Go SDK failing on single-backtick wrapped JSON with CRLFs.
kevin: can you paste the raw assistant text?
anna: example we saw:
`{
  "user_id": 42,
}`
drew: single backtick + CRLF + trailing comma. our JS extractor handles triple fences but not single ticks; Go calls json.Unmarshal and dies.
kevin: plan: add cross-sdk util ExtractJSONPayload(raw string) exported from sdk-utils (js/go). heuristics: normalize CRLF->LF, strip surrounding backticks/quotes, prefer fenced ```json blocks, else locate matching { ... } region, run small cleanup: remove trailing commas before } and ], then parse.
anna: make the helper tolerant but add opt-in strict mode: strictStructured:true to require exact JSON. docs should call that out.
drew: add unit tests: single/backtick fence, CRLFs, inline prefix like "Here's the json:", trailing commas, arrays with comments. Also ensure numbers with commas (1,000) aren't mangled — only remove commas adjacent to braces.
kevin: telemetry: emit structured_extract_attempt with tags sdk, success/failure, heuristic=fenced|brace-slice|none. ticket analytics team to see model variance.
support-bot: customer ticket #C-4829 updated with workaround (call ExtractJSONPayload in try/catch).
kevin: also discovered an auth edge: when 401s happen mid-function-call stream, some SDKs auto-retry and we get duplicated tool invocations. change: for function-call flows, surface auth errors and skip automatic retry; caller can decide to re-run.
ci-bot: CI started for branch fix/structured-extract-1773 (#PR-9077).
kevin: PR will include js/go util, tests, docs snippet, telemetry hook, and a short KB entry. planning hotfix to 1.1.x and 1.2.x.
ci-bot: build passed (4/4) on fix/structured-extract-1773.
anna: verified with customer's snippet — fixes their case. good to backport. :white_check_mark:
